brief:
Israeli occupation forces' continuing violations in Gaza aim to deepen chaos, according to Dr. Muhammad Mislih, a researcher and expert on Israeli affairs, Shehab Wire reported. Mislih attributed the pattern to Israeli internal politics rather than military necessity alone.

The researcher said the sustained assault on the strip, particularly the targeting of security and police personnel, connects directly to political calculations and complications within Israeli domestic affairs. Mislih described the violations as part of a broader strategy tied to factional disputes and political pressures inside Israel.
